# Security Officer
1. Your direct superior is the Head of Security.
2. Standard [color=#00a933]Code Green[/color] equipment is:
in
or
3. Security Officers are to perform patrols of the station to provide a visible presence of Security on the station.
4. Security Officers are expected to keep all conflicts contained and limited in scope of who is affected, with as few innocent casualties as is realistic.
5. Before arresting a crewmember, Security Officers must inform the targeted party that they are under arrest while including what crime they are being arrested for.
